neighbours.label: web-site vocabulary in software text: ' sites' meaning websites ('Microsoft sites', 'Trusted sites') and ' Web' in product names ('IBM WebSphere'); not a physical site or a spider's web

notes: Weak pole (max 5.7; 11% of strong activations in the gate-closed regime). Card: peaks ' Web' x3, ' sites' x2, ' http' x2, 'HTTP' x2, '.Site', '_site'.
